lead.titleZh: 妊娠期监督运动与乳腺癌运动处方：今日两项高分系统综述
lead.titleEn: Supervised Exercise in Pregnancy & Exercise Prescription for Breast Cancer: Two Top-Scoring Systematic Reviews Today
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共 16 篇条目，骨科与肌骨、神经康复、运动康复是主要关注点。最高分是两篇并列 90 分的系统综述，分别提供了妊娠期监督运动和乳腺癌女性运动处方的高级别证据，值得重点关注。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's 16 entries focus on orthopedic & musculoskeletal, neurorehabilitation, and exercise rehabilitation. Two systematic reviews, both scoring 90, provide high-level evidence on supervised exercise during pregnancy and exercise prescription for women with breast cancer, warranting close attention.

items.title: Effects of supervised exercise during pregnancy on gestational diabetes mellitus and other pregnancy outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis (19 studies, n=6213) found that supervised exercise during pregnancy significantly reduced the risk of gestational diabetes (RR 0.74), gestational hypertension (RR 0.55), excessive gestational weight gain (RR 0.75), and macrosomia (RR 0.61), with greater effects from earlier intervention, higher adherence, combined aerobic and resistance training, and ≥150 min/week exercise.
items.curatedReason: 妊娠期在专业指导下进行运动能显著降低妊娠糖尿病、妊娠高血压、过度孕期体重增加和巨大儿的风险。建议你向孕妇推广早期干预、高依从性、结合有氧和阻力训练、每周 ≥150 分钟的中等强度运动。
items.titleZh: 妊娠期监督运动对妊娠糖尿病和其他妊娠结局的影响：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项包含 19 项研究（n=6213）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，妊娠期在专业指导下进行运动能显著降低妊娠糖尿病（RR 0.74）、妊娠高血压（RR 0.55）、过度孕期体重增加（RR 0.75）和巨大儿（RR 0.61）的风险。早期干预、高依从性、结合有氧和阻力训练、以及每周 ≥150 分钟的运动能带来更大益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Supervised exercise during pregnancy significantly reduces the risk of gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, excessive gestational weight gain, and macrosomia. You should promote early intervention, high adherence, combined aerobic and resistance training, and moderate-intensity exercise for at least 150 minutes per week to pregnant women.
items.limitation: 尽管证据确定性为中等，但由于纳入研究存在异质性（I²值较高），在解释和应用结果时仍需考虑个体差异。
items.limitationEn: Although the certainty of evidence is moderate, due to heterogeneity among included studies (high I² values), individual differences must still be considered when interpreting and applying the results.

items.title: High-impact physical activity participation and 12-month risk of joint replacement: a longitudinal mediation analysis of 17 661 patients with knee or hip osteoarthritis
items.summary: A longitudinal mediation analysis (n=17,661) found that high-impact physical activity was associated with 36–48% lower odds of total hip replacement (THR) at 12 months, and was not associated with an altered risk of total knee replacement (TKR) in patients with hip or knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 高强度体力活动非但没有增加髋膝关节置换风险，反而与髋关节置换的较低风险相关。这意味着对于骨关节炎患者，在症状允许和功能容量支持下，应鼓励他们进行更高强度的活动，而不必过度规避。
items.titleZh: 高强度体力活动参与与 12 个月关节置换风险：对 17,661 名髋膝骨关节炎患者的纵向中介分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 17,661 名髋膝骨关节炎患者进行的纵向中介分析发现，高强度体力活动与 12 个月时全髋关节置换（THR）的风险降低 36%–48% 相关，且未改变全膝关节置换（TKR）的风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-impact physical activity not only did not increase the risk of hip and knee replacement, but was associated with a lower risk of hip replacement. This means that for osteoarthritis patients, they should be encouraged to engage in higher-impact activities, when symptoms allow and functional capacity supports it, without excessive avoidance.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性队列研究，尽管进行了多因素调整，但仍可能存在未测量混杂因素，不能建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational cohort study; despite multi-factor adjustments, unmeasured confounders may still exist, precluding causal inference.

items.title: Effects of Using High-Frequency TENS During an Exercise Therapy Program in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized sham-controlled trial (n=96) found that adding high-frequency transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation to an exercise therapy program did not provide additional benefits over sham stimulation for knee osteoarthritis pain or other outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 高频 TENS 对膝骨关节炎运动疗法的增益并不显著。在临床实践中，您不应将高频 TENS 视为提升运动疗法效果的关键补充手段。
items.titleZh: 高频 TENS 在膝骨关节炎运动疗法中的效果：一项随机假对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机假对照试验（n=96）显示，在膝骨关节炎患者的运动疗法中加入高频经皮电神经刺激，并未比假刺激带来额外的疼痛改善或其他益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-frequency TENS does not significantly augment the benefits of exercise therapy for knee osteoarthritis. Clinically, you should not rely on high-frequency TENS as a crucial adjunct to enhance exercise therapy outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究未正式评估盲法，随访期较短，且缺乏单独运动组作为对照。
items.limitationEn: The study did not formally assess blinding, had a short follow-up period, and lacked an exercise-only control group.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: This RCT (n=76) found that an individualized swimming and education program was more effective than education alone for short-term (8 weeks) improvement in disability (RMDQ MD -2.5, 95% CI -4.5 to -0.5) and pain intensity in patients with chronic low back pain, though benefits were not sustained at 52 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性下腰痛，结合游泳和教育的干预方案在短期内（8 周）比单纯教育更能有效改善残疾。这意味着游泳可作为慢性腰痛患者短期干预的有效手段，但在长期效果上仍需更多支持。
items.titleZh: 个体化游泳与教育项目对慢性下腰痛的有效性（EduSwim）：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=76）发现，针对慢性下腰痛患者，个体化的游泳与教育项目在短期（8 周）内比单纯教育更能有效改善残疾（RMDQ 平均差异 -2.5，95% CI -4.5 至 -0.5）和疼痛强度，但其益处在 52 周时未能持续。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic low back pain, a combined swimming and education intervention is more effective than education alone for short-term (8-week) disability improvement. This suggests swimming can be an effective short-term intervention for chronic LBP, but long-term efficacy requires further support.
items.limitation: 短期内效果显著，但这种改善在 52 周时未能持续，且干预组不良事件略多，需要注意患者筛选和长期依从性。
items.limitationEn: The significant short-term effects were not sustained at 52 weeks, and the intervention group had more adverse events, necessitating careful patient screening and long-term adherence considerations.

items.title: Test-Retest Reliability of an Isometric Trunk Flexor and Extensor Test in Community-Dwelling Adults
items.summary: A test-retest reliability study (n=29) in healthy adults found that the VALD ForceFrame Strength Testing System showed excellent reliability for isometric trunk flexion (ICC=0.83-0.86) and extension (ICC=0.86-0.97) strength measurements.
items.curatedReason: VALD ForceFrame 系统在评估社区成人躯干屈伸肌力量变化方面显示出良好的重测信度。如果您在临床实践中需要标准化、可靠的躯干力量测量工具，该系统是一个值得考虑的选择。
items.titleZh: 社区成人等长躯干屈伸肌测试的重测信度。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康成人（n=29）的重测信度研究发现，VALD ForceFrame 力量测试系统在等长躯干屈曲（ICC=0.83-0.86）和伸展（ICC=0.86-0.97）力量测量中表现出卓越的信度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The VALD ForceFrame system demonstrated excellent test-retest reliability for assessing changes in trunk flexor and extensor strength in community-dwelling adults. If you require a standardized and reliable trunk strength measurement tool in your clinical practice, this system is a viable option.
items.limitation: 研究对象是健康成人，其结果在脊柱病理患者人群中的适用性有待进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study involved healthy adults, and the applicability of its findings to patients with spinal pathologies requires further validation.

items.title: Effects of TENS, NMES, and Combination Therapy on Hemiplegic Shoulder Pain and Function After Stroke.
items.summary: This prospective randomized study (n=60) found that combined TENS and NMES significantly reduced hemiplegic shoulder pain and improved SPADI scores more than TENS alone, and also improved shoulder ROM, in acute and subacute stroke patients, when added to a standardized rehabilitation program.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后偏瘫肩痛的早期康复，整合电刺激可能比单一模式效果更好，尤其在疼痛和肩关节功能方面。尽管对整体运动功能和痉挛影响不大，但可作为一种有益的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: TENS、NMES 及联合疗法对卒中后偏瘫肩痛和功能的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性随机研究（n=60）发现，在急性及亚急性卒中患者的标准康复计划中，联合使用 TENS 和 NMES 能显著减轻偏瘫肩痛、改善肩痛与残疾指数（SPADI）评分，并增加肩关节活动度，效果优于单独使用 TENS。
items.curatedReasonEn: For early stroke rehabilitation, integrated electrical stimulation may be more effective than unimodal approaches for hemiplegic shoulder pain and function. While not significantly impacting overall motor function or spasticity, it can be a beneficial adjunct.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且结合疗法与NMES单用在SPADI评分上无显著差异，提示仍需更大规模研究验证长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size, and the combined therapy showed no significant difference compared to NMES alone on SPADI scores, suggesting larger studies are needed to confirm long-term effects.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Machine learning-based identification of a minimal wearable sensor for gait assessment in vestibular schwannoma
items.summary: A study used machine learning to identify optimal wearable sensor configurations for gait assessment in vestibular schwannoma, finding that a wrist-worn sensor during eyes-closed gait (FGA8) provided 60-83% accuracy in discriminating patients from controls, suggesting a minimal, clinically deployable solution for objective gait analysis.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，在闭眼步态任务中佩戴腕部传感器，对前庭神经鞘瘤患者的步态评估准确率可达60-83%。这个方案操作简便，可能成为门诊或远程监测前庭功能障碍患者步态和平衡的补充工具，但目前还不能替代全面的临床评估。
items.titleZh: 基于机器学习识别用于前庭神经鞘瘤步态评估的最少可穿戴传感器
items.summaryZh: 一项研究利用机器学习识别出用于前庭神经鞘瘤步态评估的最优可穿戴传感器配置，发现闭眼步态（FGA8）期间的腕部传感器在区分患者和对照组方面达到60-83%的准确率，提示了一种用于客观步态分析的最小化、临床可部署解决方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study suggests that a wrist-worn sensor during eyes-closed gait tasks can achieve 60-83% accuracy in assessing gait for vestibular schwannoma patients. While this simple solution could supplement in-clinic or remote monitoring of gait and balance in patients with vestibular disorders, it's not yet a substitute for comprehensive clinical evaluation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（32名患者），且结果主要基于机器学习模型的分类准确性而非临床结局的直接改善。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (32 patients), and the results are primarily based on the classification accuracy of machine learning models rather than direct improvements in clinical outcomes.

items.title: Peripheral arterial disease: adverse impacts, disparities in outcomes, and the path ahead.
items.summary: The third paper in a Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) Series describes the devastating individual effects of PAD, including chronic pain, functional limitation, and loss of independence, while highlighting disparities in outcomes among underserved groups. It recommends improving disease awareness, introducing multidisciplinary care models including exercise therapy, and modifying healthcare services to provide better access.
items.curatedReason: 这份 PAD 系列论文强调了多学科护理模型的重要性，尤其提到运动疗法作为选定患者的治疗选项，并指出医疗服务不公平性对弱势群体的影响。它重申了康复在 PAD 管理中的核心地位。
items.titleZh: 外周动脉疾病：不利影响、结局差异及未来之路
items.summaryZh: 外周动脉疾病（PAD）系列论文的第三篇描述了 PAD 对个体造成的破坏性影响，包括慢性疼痛、功能受限和独立性丧失，同时强调了弱势群体在结局上的差异。论文建议提高疾病认知、引入包括运动疗法在内的多学科护理模式，并调整医疗服务以改善可及性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PAD Series paper highlights the importance of multidisciplinary care models, specifically mentioning exercise therapy as a treatment option for selected patients, and addresses healthcare inequities affecting underserved groups. It reaffirms the central role of rehabilitation in PAD management.

items.title: Optimising exercise prescription for cancer-related fatigue, lean mass, physical function and muscle strength in women with breast cancer: a systematic review with dose-response network meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and dose-response network meta-analysis (64 trials, n=5156) found that combined exercise was most effective for improving cancer-related fatigue and lean mass, while resistance exercise was most effective for physical function and muscle strength in women with breast cancer, with significant benefits achievable at doses as low as 10–40 min/week.
items.curatedReason: 对于乳腺癌患者，结合有氧和阻力训练能最有效改善疲劳和瘦体重，而阻力训练则对体能和肌力最有效。即便每周仅需 10-40 分钟，也能带来显著益处。你应将个体化、混合型训练方案作为一线推荐，并强调低剂量也能起效。
items.titleZh: 优化乳腺癌女性癌症相关疲劳、瘦体重、体能和肌力锻炼处方：一项系统综述与剂量-反应网络 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项包含 64 项试验（n=5156）的系统综述和剂量-反应网络 Meta 分析发现，在乳腺癌女性中，联合运动对改善癌症相关疲劳和瘦体重最有效，而阻力运动对改善体能和肌力最有效，每周仅 10-40 分钟的低剂量也能带来显著益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: For breast cancer patients, combined aerobic and resistance exercise is most effective for fatigue and lean mass, while resistance exercise is best for physical function and strength. Even 10-40 minutes per week yields significant benefits. You should recommend individualized, mixed training programs as a first-line approach, emphasizing that low doses can also be effective.
items.limitation: 虽然提供了剂量-反应关系，但由于研究异质性，仍需在临床实践中根据个体情况精细调整，以实现最佳效果。
items.limitationEn: Although dose-response relationships are provided, due to study heterogeneity, precise individual adjustments are still needed in clinical practice to achieve optimal effects.

items.title: Exercise prehabilitation in breast cancer: an emerging target to improve surgical outcomes
items.summary: This editorial highlights exercise-based prehabilitation as a promising strategy to enhance cardiorespiratory fitness and accelerate recovery in various cancer populations, suggesting its potential to prevent postoperative complications in breast cancer patients, an area currently underexplored.
items.curatedReason: 运动预康复在乳腺癌患者中具有改善手术结局的巨大潜力，尤其是在降低术后并发症方面。作为物理治疗师，你可以将运动预康复作为乳腺癌患者围手术期管理的重要组成部分，主动与外科团队协作。
items.titleZh: 乳腺癌患者的运动预康复：改善手术结局的新兴目标
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评强调，以运动为基础的预康复是一种有前景的策略，可以提高多种癌症患者的心肺适能并加速康复，同时指出其在预防乳腺癌患者术后并发症方面的潜力尚未充分开发。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise prehabilitation holds great potential for improving surgical outcomes in breast cancer patients, particularly in reducing postoperative complications. As a physical therapist, you can integrate exercise prehabilitation as a critical component of perioperative management for breast cancer patients, proactively collaborating with surgical teams.

items.title: Longitudinal cohort study of the association between labral pathology and cartilage loss in high-impact athletes: the FORCe study
items.summary: A longitudinal cohort study (n=173 high-impact athletes) found weak-to-moderate associations between baseline anterior labral tears (aIRR 1.46), paralabral cysts (aIRR 1.38), and labral sum score (aIRR 1.05) with subsequent cartilage loss (sum change score) over 2-3 years, suggesting these contribute to cartilage loss.
items.curatedReason: 盂唇损伤（尤其是前盂唇撕裂和盂唇旁囊肿）与高冲击运动员髋关节软骨丢失存在关联。这意味着在评估和管理这类运动员时，应警惕盂唇损伤对软骨退变的潜在影响，并考虑制定预防策略。
items.titleZh: 盂唇病变与高冲击运动员软骨丢失关联的纵向队列研究：FORCe 研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 173 名高冲击运动员的纵向队列研究发现，基线前盂唇撕裂（调整后发生率比 1.46）、盂唇旁囊肿（1.38）和盂唇总分（1.05）与随后的 2-3 年软骨丢失（总变化评分）存在中度至弱相关性，提示这些因素可能导致软骨丢失。
items.curatedReasonEn: Labral pathology (especially anterior labral tears and paralabral cysts) is associated with hip cartilage loss in high-impact athletes. This means that when assessing and managing these athletes, clinicians should be aware of the potential impact of labral injuries on cartilage degeneration and consider developing preventive strategies.
items.limitation: 观察性研究，且盂唇损伤与软骨丢失的关联强度中等偏弱，提示还有其他重要因素影响软骨退变。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational study, and the association between labral tears and cartilage loss was modest to weak, suggesting other significant factors contribute to cartilage degeneration.

items.title: Cornerstone of healthy ageing: preserving skeletal muscle to delay age-related musculoskeletal disease and maintain functional independence
items.summary: This editorial highlights that preserving skeletal muscle mass and function is essential for healthy aging, preventing disability, and delaying the onset of age-related musculoskeletal diseases like osteoporosis and osteoarthritis, recognizing sarcopenia as a major contributor to morbidity and functional decline.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调了骨骼肌对健康老龄化的核心作用，提示我们应将保护肌肉完整性作为预防老年人残疾和延缓骨关节疾病的关键策略。在临床实践中，要重视并强化肌力训练和功能性活动。
items.titleZh: 健康老龄化的基石：保护骨骼肌以延缓衰老相关肌肉骨骼疾病并维持功能独立性
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评强调，保护骨骼肌的质量和功能对于健康老龄化、预防残疾和延缓骨质疏松、骨关节炎等衰老相关肌肉骨骼疾病至关重要，并指出肌肉减少症是导致老年人发病率和功能衰退的主要因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary underscores the central role of skeletal muscle in healthy aging, suggesting that preserving muscle integrity is a key strategy for preventing disability and delaying musculoskeletal diseases in older adults. In clinical practice, emphasize and enhance strength training and functional activities.

items.title: Predictors of response to spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling and exercise in patients with cervicogenic headache.
items.summary: A secondary analysis (n=142) found that male sex (OR 3.906) and higher baseline headache intensity (OR 1.708) were the strongest predictors of successful outcomes (≥50% improvement) at 3 months in cervicogenic headache patients treated with spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling, and exercise.
items.curatedReason: 在颈源性头痛患者中，男性和基线头痛强度更高是脊柱手法、干针和运动联合治疗成功预后的最强预测因子。这意味着在治疗这类患者时，可将性别和初始疼痛水平作为参考因素。
items.titleZh: 颈源性头痛患者对脊柱手法治疗、干针和运动疗法反应的预测因素
items.summaryZh: 一项对 142 名颈源性头痛患者的二次分析发现，男性（OR 3.906）和较高的基线头痛强度（OR 1.708）是患者在接受脊柱手法治疗、干针和运动疗法后 3 个月内获得成功结局（疼痛改善≥50%）的最强预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: For cervicogenic headache patients, male sex and higher baseline headache intensity are the strongest predictors of successful outcomes with combined spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling, and exercise. This suggests that sex and initial pain levels can be used as reference factors when treating such patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为一项既往 RCT 的二次分析，结果的普适性可能受限于原始研究的设计和人群。
items.limitationEn: This study is a secondary analysis of a previous RCT, and the generalizability of the findings may be limited by the original study's design and population.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Ahpra and the National Boards invite feedback on practitioner codes of conduct
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) and the National Boards are reviewing practitioner codes of conduct, inviting health practitioners, consumers, and stakeholders to participate in an early scoping survey by October 15, 2026, to help shape the updates.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）正在审查其行为准则。你作为在澳大利亚执业的物理治疗师，应抓住机会通过参与调查提供反馈，以确保修订后的行为准则能够准确反映行业需求和公众期望，这将直接影响你未来的执业标准和职业伦理。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构——Ahpra 和国家委员会征集从业者行为准则反馈意见

items.title: How APTA Is Advancing Alternative Payment Models
items.summary: APTA is piloting its GOALS (Growing Older and Living Stronger) model, an early frailty identification and intervention program, with Hartford HealthCare. This initiative aims to generate real-world evidence for value-based care and payment, measuring outcomes like function, falls, and hospitalizations to inform future payment for PT services.
